vulnerable_code:
class Ability
  include CanCan::Ability

  def initialize(user)
    return unless user.present?

    can :create, RefundRequest, order: { user_id: user.id }
    # Flaw: update permits modifying any pending refund request regardless of order ownership
    can :update, RefundRequest, order: { status: 'pending' }
  end
end

class Returns::RefundsController < ApplicationController
  def update
    @refund = RefundRequest.find(params[:id])
    authorize! :update, @refund

    @refund.update!(refund_params)
    render json: @refund
  end
end
diagnosis: The Ability rule for :update on RefundRequest checks that order status is pending but fails to check order: { user_id: user.id }. Any customer can alter refund payout amounts and recipient account numbers on pending return claims submitted by other shoppers.
